system.description: As an action coat your skin with a coating of hardened stone that looks nearly indistinguishable from regular skin. Until your next rest, gain armor with the following stats (5s, 4p, 3b), each armor value is increased by your Arcane Might. This armor does not stack with armor granted through Chakra Surge. This armor has the Hard trait, but does not impede any abilities that require you to not be wearing any armor with that trait, such as Duelist.
